title: Change the MAC address of a network interface
summary: Modify the hardware (MAC) address of a network interface. This is often used for privacy or testing purposes.

steps.explain: Use `sudo ip link set` with the `address` option to set a new MAC address.

placeholders.name: INTERFACE
placeholders.description: The name of the network interface.

placeholders.name: MAC_ADDRESS
placeholders.description: The new MAC address in format xx:xx:xx:xx:xx:xx.

alternatives.explain: Use the short form `sudo ip l s` with `a` for address.

placeholders.name: INTERFACE
placeholders.description: The name of the network interface.

placeholders.name: MAC_ADDRESS
placeholders.description: The new MAC address in format xx:xx:xx:xx:xx:xx.

rollback.explain: To restore the original MAC address, you typically need to reboot the system or reload the driver, as the original address is stored in hardware/firmware. There is no direct command to revert to the permanent MAC address via `ip link`.

warnings: Changing the MAC address can disrupt network connectivity and may violate network policies.
The change is temporary and will be lost after a reboot.
